newsitem.title: USA: NYC awards Morgan Stanley $120 mln taxable bonds.
newsitem.headline: NYC awards Morgan Stanley $120 mln taxable bonds.

text.p: New York City on Wednesday said that its sale of $120 million of taxable bonds attracted 10 bids, a sign of strong interest, adding Morgan Stanley submitted the winning bid.

The New York City official, who declined to be named, said that Morgan Stanley won the bonds by bidding for them with a true interest cost of 7.349221 percent. A bid from Goldman Sachs & Co was the second highest at 7.354871 percent.
